name: ui-ux-audit
description: Three-phase UI/UX and accessibility auditing (Figma design, UI code, running app via Argent) with guided intake, a choosable audit scope, a go/no-go verdict with WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 status per level, audit memory that builds each re-audit on the last, reproducible scoring, an adversarial verification gate, and a themed HTML/PDF report with screenshots taken through the MCP and marked at the finding.
